opening.argument: The demonstration runs on a blockchain fork hosted locally, with the speaker presenting the exercise as a test of whether the code works. The price movement is also disclosed: a large purchase is used to create an artificial opportunity, not presented as an ordinary investment result. In that setting, the deployment, testing, and flash-loan arbitrage mechanics serve a programming demonstration. The description markets a paid DeFi bot programming course and discount, but the supplied material does not promise guaranteed returns or ask viewers to transfer funds, surrender credentials, or join a deceptive scheme.
